ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by a predominantly low-intensity (dark) left lobe and a high-intensity (white) right lobe, with a total distribution of approximately 45% black to 55% white pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe presents a contiguous dark pixel mass with white mottling concentrated at the interior trailing edge. The right lobe is a contiguous high-intensity white field with dark longitudinal streaks and localized mottling along the trailing edge and near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and deep vertical incision relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge shows high-amplitude, low-frequency jagged peaks near the distal tip. Left lobe exhibits lower-amplitude, medium-frequency irregularities along the medial posterior boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges exhibit a distinct sigmoid curve (convex near the notch, transitioning to concave towards the distal tips).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark, circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) visible in the lower interior region of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark linear marks (rake marks) on the left lobe oriented diagonally from the leading edge; two vertical dark linear marks visible on the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct, parallel, high-contrast linear artifacts (consistent with rope or gear entanglement) originate near the median notch and extend downward into the water column at the bottom-right frame.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tip of the left fluke appears to have a unique jagged excision or irregular tissue loss compared to the right tip.
